Despite name, classical maximum Hausdorff distance. edge_chamfer: Mean two directed mean nearest-boundary distances. text: mode = "dem", geomorphons calculated internally. large DEMs, may trigger automatic tiled processing workflow. See geomorphons() details. title: rgeomorphon 0.4.0

Added scorpion sample dataset (10 m USGS 3DEP DEM co-registered SSURGO mukey raster map unit attributes) vignette Terrain Realism (PTRM) Structural Concordance ‘rgeomorphon’.
